about.description: Roofstock onChain tokenizes individual homes by placing each property into a single-member entity and allowing ownership to transfer through a wallet-native purchase flow. The model is designed to compress closing-style friction into a faster settlement experience while keeping the asset anchored to real-world title and entity records. It targets buyers seeking direct property ownership outcomes with a more streamlined, digital-first purchasing process.
